notes.title: Pre-Alpha Demo is Here — Time to Bleed
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040883/1f2a9fd5c3c932d433d9a44c6c29e9a6b1a166e3.png
The world is dead — but the demo is alive!

Steam Fest: Zombies vs Vampires has officially begun — and so has the chaos.
Jump into the first-ever public build of Times of Survival, our brutal top-down zombie survival game. It’s raw, it's unforgiving, and you're the last line of defense.

What to Expect:

Single-player experience — you’re on your own out there
Raw, dirty combat — shoot, smash, survive
One mission: hold the base or die trying
60+ minutes of gameplay with crafting and survival
5 types of zombies, 3 ranged weapons, 3 melee


How to Join the Fight:

Download the free demo now on our Steam page;
Share your feedback in our Discord community;
Wishlist the game to stay updated — every click helps us survive!


💥 You’re not just playing — you’re helping us build the world.
Now grab your gear and get bloody.

notes.title: Closed Playtest for Times of Survival!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040883/a2be3dc0a3d095c83eee9a83bd8eb92484908f9e.png
Playtest time!
We’re excited to open up a closed playtest for our upcoming action-RPG survival game, Times of Survival! This is an early development build, and we’re looking for 10-15 players to help us shape the game. 
How to Apply:

Join our community on discord;
Visit our Steam page and add the game to your wishlist.
Fill out the form announced in our Discord community and stay tuned!

You’ll receive your invitation via email.
